map.算例：金属基材开胶脱落的工况风险诊断: Example: service-condition risk diagnosis of debonding on a metal substrate
map.风险等级是怎么算出来的？: How is the risk level calculated?
map.按工况预警条数分级：2 条及以上为「高」、1 条为「中」、无预警为「低」。预警来: Graded by the number of service warnings: 2 or more is High, 1 is Medium, none is Low. Warnings come from four conditions: inadequate surface preparation (untreated / cleaned only), too-short cure (0-10 min), excessive service temperature (>120 C), and low-surface-energy substrates (plastic / rubber).
map.固化时间填 0 会怎样？: What happens if cure time is entered as 0?
map.固化时间为 0 或负数时无法形成有效粘接，工具会提示「固化时间须大于 0 分钟」: A cure time of 0 or negative cannot form a valid bond; the tool shows "Cure time must be greater than 0 min" and stops the diagnosis, never returning Low risk. Enter a positive cure time per the actual process.

map.输入：现象「开胶脱落」、基材「金属」、工况温度 25℃、固化时间 30 min、: Input: symptom "debonding", substrate "metal", service temperature 25 C, cure time 30 min, surface preparation "cleaned only". The tool gives 3 possible causes (surface contamination / oil residue, wrong adhesive, insufficient curing) with corrective actions; 1 service warning: inadequate surface preparation is the main cause of interface failure (cleaned only), so abrade or prime before bonding; temperature 25 C and cure 30 min are normal and trigger no high-temperature or short-cure warning. Risk level Medium (1 warning). Action priority: clean and degrease and abrade the substrate first, prime if needed, then recheck adhesive compatibility.

map.不一定。本页只把它作为通用提示线索；是否固化不足须结合胶种、配比、温度、胶层厚度: Not necessarily. This page treats it only as a generic clue; whether cure is incomplete depends on the adhesive, mix ratio, temperature, bond-line thickness and the manufacturer cure profile.
